title: English: a coached 'digital arrest' victim, payment blocked
note: Customer: a scripted text-to-speech voice, not a real person. Ruko: the live Bolna agent.
detail: Our second test call (23 Oct). The customer admits a 'CBI officer' is on a video call with her; Ruko stops the payment and offers to call her son. It still has Bolna's default filler line ('Just give me a moment…'), which we have since replaced.
timing: Transcript from Bolna. The highlight is timed to Bolna's recording, which leaves out silences, so it is approximate.

turns.text: Hi Kamla, Ruko here, Demo Bank's automated safety line, on a recorded call. Your code word is BADAL 84. Does it match your app?
Okay. Your app shows you were on a call while paying. What's this payment for, and who were you speaking with?
it's for my nephew's college fees
Just give me a moment, I'll be back with you. Has someone said RBI is holding money, a prize or a payout for you?
Has someone said RBI is holding money, a
acbi officer is on a video call with me
Just give me a moment, I'll be back with you.
and i must move my savings to a safe custody account
For your safety, this payment is stopped. Your money is safe in your account. Shall I call Ravi, your son, so you can talk it over? Hello? Are you there?
